note: intendedReleaseDate is the candidate's declared intended release date, not a statement that the change has shipped. Nicki (owner) confirms the real release date. If it differs, change intendedReleaseDate here AND the dates listed under pages (JSON-LD dateModified, visible 'Updated:' where visibleUpdated is true, sitemap.xml lastmod for the url) to that date; that date-only change is a new patch hash and needs re-validation. Before release set status to CONFIRMED and confirmedBy, then run: npm run release-gate -- --ship-date=YYYY-MM-DD. Unrelated historical dates are out of scope.
